name: 80021 · Broomfield, CO
findings: ZIP 80021 (Broomfield) has 133 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80021 (Broomfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
